# Bitmint Lab

> Bitmint Lab is a software product company based in Amravati, India. We build SaaS products, business software, websites, e-commerce applications and mobile apps.

Official website: https://bitmintlab.in/

## Products

- [All products](https://bitmintlab.in/products/): Overview of Bitmint Lab products.
- [NOTIQ](https://bitmintlab.in/products/notiq.html): Business messaging and customer communication platform.
- [Shala ERP](https://bitmintlab.in/products/shala-erp.html): School management ERP software.
- [HR-Lab](https://bitmintlab.in/products/hr-lab.html): Human resources management software.
- [LMS Platform](https://bitmintlab.in/products/lms-platform.html): Learning management platform.
- [AI Assistant](https://bitmintlab.in/products/ai-assistant.html): AI knowledge assistant.
- [Business ERP](https://bitmintlab.in/products/business-erp.html): Business management software.
- [CRM](https://bitmintlab.in/products/crm.html): Customer relationship management software.
- [Paper Trading](https://bitmintlab.in/products/paper-trading.html): Paper-trading product information.

## Company and Services

- [Home and services](https://bitmintlab.in/): Company overview, custom software, web and mobile development, and contact.
